opening: I have pain in my belly.
The belly pain and the nausea started 6 days ago.
I've been constipated for a long time.

I've had my appendix taken out.

opening.text: I have pain in my belly and I feel nauseated. The belly pain and the nausea started 6 days ago. I've been constipated for a long time. For the past week I've been taking anti-inflammatory painkillers for the discomfort in my legs. I've had my appendix taken out and I've had a hysterectomy.
